---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a change or addition to LORM
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**Affected layer** (check one)
- [ ] SPEC.md (normative model — new invariant, level semantics, lifecycle rule)
- [ ] skills/lorm (agent skill behavior)
- [ ] hooks/ (enforcement engine, classifiers)
- [ ] schema/lorm-policy.schema.json (new policy field or capability)
- [ ] docs/ or examples/
- [ ] other / not sure

**Problem**
What situation isn't well covered today? Concrete scenario, not just "it
would be nice if…".

**Proposed change**
What you'd add or change. If it touches SPEC.md, note whether it's a new
MUST/SHOULD or a clarification of existing normative text.

**Alternatives considered**
Other ways to solve the same problem, and why you're proposing this one.

**Compatibility**
Does this require a new policy schema version, or is it additive/backward
compatible with existing `lorm-policy.yaml` files?

**Anything else**
Links to related issues, prior art, or discussion.
